svg.title: The four warning signs Medina reports the Court uses, in the 39 sampled laws where no challenge was found
svg.desc: Stacked bars for four warning signs, the beneficiary sign in two versions, across 39 sampled laws where no challenge was found. Alters, in a way others would not share, the position of the government or an officeholder in a matter live on the day it passed: 3 present, 36 absent, 0 not known; Addresses a specific interest of the government or an officeholder, on its text: 3 present, 36 absent, 0 not known; Takes effect within a year, and not only after the next election: 36 present, 3 absent, 0 not known; No opposition member voted for it at the final reading: 5 present, 8 absent, 26 not known; Expedited: final vote within 30 days of first reading, or a shortened committee stage: 18 present, 13 absent, 8 not known. All four signs can be scored on 12 laws: 1 show 1, 9 show 2, 2 show 3.
svg.text: MEASURED
The four warning signs Medina reports the Court uses, in the 39 sampled laws where no
challenge was found
Each bar is one sign across the same laws: how many show it, how many do not, and how many cannot be scored from the surviving
record. The beneficiary sign is shown in both its versions. The thresholds are the project's own (note, T1 as revised, step
Alters, in a way others would not share, the position of the government or an officeholder in a matter live on the day it passed (situated; the primary version)
3 present, 36 absent, 0 not known
Addresses a specific interest of the government or an officeholder, on its text (named; the secondary version)
3 present, 36 absent, 0 not known
Takes effect within a year, and not only after the next election
36 present, 3 absent, 0 not known
No opposition member voted for it at the final reading
5 present, 8 absent, 26 not known
Expedited: final vote within 30 days of first reading, or a shortened committee stage
18 present, 13 absent, 8 not known
Sign present
Sign absent
Not known from the record
All four signs can be scored on 12 of the 39 laws: 1 show one, 9 show two, 2 show three. Not known is drawn as such, never as absent: for most
laws passed before October 2003 no surviving record names the voters at the final reading.
Scope: Israel; laws titled Basic Law, 1958 to 2026. Sample: every third law in the full list with no challenge found, in order of passage,
from the first (change log (ah), (al)); no challenge was found in the searches made, which did not reach the court database. Coded by two
coders from legislative records without opening any judgment, the situated sign by a separate reader, and disagreements settled by an
adjudicator. Source: codebook/comparison-sample.csv. Table: figures/data/fig3-signs-in-sample.csv.
